records.result: Resolved. Lokale Regelgeving search now positively lists Huisvestingsverordening Deventer 2026 as a Deventer regulation, valid from 07-02-2026 through 06-02-2030. The current municipal woningsplitsing page directly references Huisvestingsverordening Deventer 2026 and states that no separate splitsingsvergunning is required for division into apartment rights, while technical building permission is required for dwelling splitting. The current municipal room-rental page also explicitly states that the omzettingsvergunning for room rental is governed by Huisvestingsverordening Deventer 2026. The former draft/future-law signal is therefore promoted to current law and removed from adoption-watch status.

No official adopted Huisvestingsverordening Brummen 2026 surfaced in the final current-publication search. Current Lokale Regelgeving results do surface other adopted 2026 Brummen instruments, demonstrating that the publication source is current, while the municipal housing page still identifies the housing regulation as concept. The concept therefore remains a monitored positive future-law signal, not an unresolved unknown and not current law.
